Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this high-profile encounter. However, the action coninues on this Super Sunday as Sri Lanka Women take on Bangladesh Women in the second game. That game will start at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). So switch tabs and enjoy the coverage of that game. Cheers!

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says that it was a good game and Pakistan batted well and they wanted to win this game. Applauds Jemimah Rodrigues and Richa Ghosh for their performance and says that everyone is looking to do well whenever the opportunity comes. Mentions that all the games are crucial but a win against Pakistan is always special. Says that the crowd support was good and they enjoyed the game. Informs that they would like to work in the nets before the next game and sort out things that did not went well in this game.

Bismah Maroof, the skipper of Pakistan Women says that they were in the game all the time and adds that India played well but they made a lot of mistakes in the bowling department. Hopes to do well in the next game. Says that the girls were given the role before thew game and they did well in this game. Applauds Ayesha Naseem for the knock she played.

Jemimah Rodrigues is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says that she does not know what to say but they needed a partnership and wanted to take the game deep. Tells that she had a good partnership with Richa Ghosh earlier and so they were confident. Mentions that the knock in this game means a lot to her as she has not scored much in the last few games. Adds that they knew that they can win the game if they bat till the end as they needed 10 runs per over and they knew that bad ball would come and they just had to take advantage of them. Tells that it was a difficult wicket and bit of two-paced but the set batters could score runs on it. States that it was a team effort and they would let this win sink in but adds that the tournament has just begun and they want to do the process right and result will take care of itself.
Time for the Presentation.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, Pakistan were in trouble when they were 4 down for not a lot but Ayesha Naseem and Bismah Maroof added 81 in no time to take them to a good score. Jemimah Rodrigues though along with Richa Ghosh played brilliantly to taken India over the line.

Pakistan will be disappointed with how the pacers bowled! Their spinners were decent, especiall, Nashra Sandhu and Sadia Iqbal but the spells from Fatima Sana and Aiman Anwer took the game away. They bowled far too many boundary balls which cost them the game. Had the two spinners got support from the others, the story could have well been different.

Chasing a stiff target, India lost a wicket early. Shafali Verma and Jemimah Rodrigues steadied the ship with a handy stand. Just as the game was drifting away from Pakistan, they got Verma. Kaur came out and played with intent but when she fell, the game was hanging in the balance. The run rate went over 10 heading into the last 4 but Jemimah Rodrigues played brilliantly, she was well supported by Richa Ghosh who survived a review and the two ensured it is India who finish on top.

That is a fine, fine innings from Jemimah Rodrigues and she is the main reason for her side getting over the line. Absolutely brilliant from her. Despite the run rate needed going up, despite seeing wickets fall at the other end, she kept her cool and has given her side a very important win.

FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues finishes it off in style! And she also brings up her fifty! Top, top knock from here. A match-winning knock. She makes room, this is full and outside off, it is smashed through covers for a boundary. INDIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
FOUR! Up and over! A boundary in the third man region! Shorter and outside off, this is upper cut over point and into the fence behind. 3 needed.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Pulled away! Need less than run-a-ball now. On the pads, this is pulled past the square leg fielder and into the fence behind.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Another yorker on off, this is jammed out to cover for one.
A yorker now on off, this is jammed out to mid off.
FOUR! Up and over! Off the front foot this time. This is probably the over which kills the game! Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Make that two in a row! This is poor bowling. Another one very short and outside off, it is cut past point for another boundary.
FOUR! Cut away! Would have been a wide had she left it! Shorter and well outside off, Richa Ghosh cuts it through point for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
A single to end but that is a massive over! On off, this is hit through covers for one.

FOUR! Misfield and four! Confusion. Not what Pakistan could afford at the moment! On middle, this is swept hard through mid-wicket. The two fielders in the deep go for it but then both leave it for each other. Boundary.
On middle, this is hit through mid-wicket for one.
Just over! On the pad, Richa Ghosh plays the slog sweep, it goes off the top edge just over short fine leg for two,
FOUR! Up and over! Handy boundary! Shorter and outside off, Richa Ghosh looks to cut, it goes over point and into the fence behind. Handy boundary.
On middle, this is swept through mid-wicket for one.

GIVE OUT LBW! Richa Ghosh seems a goner but she reviews. NOT OUT! Ultra Edge shows a spike as it passes the glove. She survives. The Indian dressing room breathes a huge sigh of relief. On middle, Richa Ghosh looks to sweep but seems to have missed it. It hits the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. Richa reviews to good use.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed to cover.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
Two! On middle, Richa Ghosh looks to sweep but it goes off the top edge, lands safe in the short fine leg region. Two.
FOUR! Pulled away! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the square leg fielder and into the fence behind.
Dots are gold! Shorter and well wide outside off, Ghosh looks to cut but misses.
Lands short! A full toss on off, this is lofted down towards long off. Not hit it well but it lands short for one.
Shorter and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues mistimes her pull towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! That is a top shot! Jemimah Rodrigues moves right across, this is on middle, she sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Welcome one.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through point for one.

That could have easily deflected back onto the stumps! Fuller and on off, this is hit hard back towards the bowler. Fatima Sana tries to stop it with her feet but it hits it and goes behind towards mid on for one.
Flatter and on off, Ghosh defends. Another top over from Nashra Sandhu!
On off, this is pushed towards cover.
On off, Richa looks to push, it goes off the outside edge towards short third man for one.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a massive, massive wicket. Pakistan back in this. Harmanpreet Kaur goes and the pressure that was built in the last few overs has paid off. This is slower one and outside off. It lands and turns away. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to play the slog sweep, it goes off the top edge and into the hands of the fielder at short third man. Bismah Maroof takes it. 57 needed in 39.
Commentary.Howout: c Bismah Maroof b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.

Time for a review! An appeal for a caught behind not given. It is reviewed. NOT OUT! Nothing on Ultra Edge! Pakistan lose a review! Tossed up outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to sweep but misses. An appeal but turned down. They also check for the stumping, replays show that Jemimah Rodrigues is in.
On middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to point.
Outside off, slower. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! India doing it easy now! On middle, this is dragged wide of the long on fielder and into the fence.
A single to end another good over for India! On middle, this is swept through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Brilliant running! Outside off, tossed up, this is swept wide of deep mid-wicket for two.
The sweep comes out, it is hit through square leg for two more.
On off, this is guided to point.
On off, this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! That is a poor ball and it is put away! Down the leg side. Kaur sweeps it down to the fine leg fence. That is a big over. Just what Pakistan did not want.
Outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
Kaur will feel she missed out! A full toss on off, this is hit to mid off for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Up and over! That is a top shot! Shorter and on off, Kaur pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. That will release the pressure.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
A dot to end! Another top over from Nashra Sandhu! On off, this is guided to point. 83 needed in 60.
The sweep comes out, it is played through square leg for one.

NOT OUT! Jemimah Rodrigues is in, in time! Really good flexibility shown by her! That though is a beauty! Tossed up on off, this lands and spins away. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to push at it but is beaten. She drags her back foot out for a second but then stretches and gets her back foot in.
Have Pakistan got two in quick succession here? A stumping appeal and it is taken upstairs. Could be close.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
The paddle scoop comes out straight away, it is played fine on the leg side for one.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch that is! Brilliant. Just as we wrote Pakistan need a wicket, they have got it. Sidra Ameen with a stunner! This is tossed up on off, Shafali Verma skips down the track and lofts it down towards long off. Sidra Ameen runs to her right, she times her leap and takes it nicely. Shows great balance to not fall over. She is pumped up and rightly so. That is a huge wicket. Shafali Verma looked in great form.
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Ameen b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Another single as this is whipped through mid-wicket. Pakistan need a wicket here. 85 needed in 66.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is whipped down to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
FOUR! Outside off, shorter, Jemimah Rodrigues waits and then plays it past the keeper, very fine and into the fence. Runs flowing now.
On middle, this is flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Yes, she can. This is a top over! On middle, this is defended.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one. Can she end the over well now?
Misfield and one! Tossed up outside off, this is hit hard but to covers.
On middle, Jemimah Rodrigues defends.
On the pads, this is swept but to square leg.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Was that th 7th ball in the over? Yes, it has cost Pakistan! Full and outside off, this is carved over point and it races away to the fence.
A single as this is hit down to long on.
Nicely played! Walks across and then whips it through mid-wicket for two.
Another single as this is pushed through covers.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Shafali Verma looks to drive but misses.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
FOUR! Up and over! A little too full this time, it is lofted over mid off for a boundary. A good Powerplay for India in the end. They are 43 for 1 after it. They need another 107.
A loud appeal but turned down! On the pads, Shafali Verma looks to flick flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

OUT! TAKEN! There is the breakthrough pakistan wanted! This partnership was going along well. Yastika Bhatia comes down the track but gets too close to the pitch of the ball. She lofts it but straight to Fatima Sana at covers.
Commentary.Howout: c Fatima Sana b Sadia Iqbal

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! That is a strong shot! Fuller and right in the zone. It is hit wide of long off for a boundary.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
FOUR! Misfield and four! On middle, this is whipped hard through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep, runs to her left but dives over the ball. Pressure off.
Tip and run! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Another dot! Tossed up on off, this is jammed out to covers.
Steps out but yorks herself! This is jammed out to covers.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to covers.

EDGY FOUR! India won't mind how they come as long as they do. Shafali Verma steps out, she fails to get to the pitch of the ball and swings, it goes off the outside edge fine on the off side and into the fence behind.

GIVE OUT BUT REVIEWED! Shafali Verma has been give out LBW but she reviews. It seems to be going down leg. NOT OUT! That is missing leg and Shafali Verma survives! This is fired into the pads, Shafali Verma looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Verma reviews and to good use.
Plays the sweep through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Bhatia pushes itbut finds mid off.
A full toss, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! A boundary to end and that is an expensive over! On the pads, this is nudged down towards fine leg and it races away to the fence.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Two more! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket for two.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two more! Outside off, this is guided through point for two.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, Shafali Verma guides it to point. A tidy start by Sadia Iqbal!
Steps out and then plays it towards mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is nudged towards mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Lands short! The slog sweep comes out, it is played towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs in but takes it on the bounce. A run.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Another easy single! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Fails to adjust to the right-hander. Slips it down the leg side. Wided.
Fuller and on off, this is driven towards cover, a slight misfield and it is an easy run.
Shorter and outside off, Yastika Bhatia looks to cut but is beaten. Good bounce there.
FOUR! Hammered! That is a strong shot. Nice way to get off the mark! Short and on middle, this is pulled wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
A really good drive but for no runs! Fuller and on off, this is driven but to covers.
